# The amd64 slice-sum vector form runs only when the archsimd feature
# check is true: the check dominates the masked tail load in the binary,
# the run reports the check value the vector path consults, and a
# check-off run still matches the scalar oracle in the program.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'simd feature gate needs amd64'
[!GOOS:linux] skip 'host cpu probe reads /proc/cpuinfo'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOAMD64=v1

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^sums ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/on.txt
exec go run ./hostprobe $WORK/on.txt baseline
stdout 'host probe ok baseline'
# The feature check precedes the masked tail load in sumI32 and sumU8.
logos build -o $WORK/exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumI32$' $WORK/exe
cp stdout $WORK/sumI32.txt
exec go run ./checkorder $WORK/sumI32.txt avx2
stdout '^order ok avx2$'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU8$' $WORK/exe
cp stdout $WORK/sumU8.txt
exec go run ./checkorder $WORK/sumU8.txt avx512
stdout '^order ok avx512$'

env GODEBUG=cpu.avx2=off
logos run .
stdout '^sums ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/off-avx2.txt
exec go run ./hostprobe $WORK/off-avx2.txt avx2off
stdout 'host probe ok avx2off'

env GODEBUG=cpu.avx512f=off
logos run .
stdout '^sums ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/off-avx512.txt
exec go run ./hostprobe $WORK/off-avx512.txt avx512off
stdout 'host probe ok avx512off'

# GOAMD64=v3 guarantees AVX2: sumI32 drops the check but keeps the
# masked tail load, while sumU8 keeps its AVX512 check in order.
env GOAMD64=v3
env GODEBUG=
logos run .
stdout '^avx2 true$'
stdout '^sums ok$'
logos build -o $WORK/exe-v3 .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumI32$' $WORK/exe-v3
cp stdout $WORK/sumI32-v3.txt
exec go run ./checkorder $WORK/sumI32-v3.txt noavx2
stdout '^order ok noavx2$'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU8$' $WORK/exe-v3
cp stdout $WORK/sumU8-v3.txt
exec go run ./checkorder $WORK/sumU8-v3.txt avx512
stdout '^order ok avx512$'

# GOAMD64=v4 guarantees AVX512 as well: sumU8 drops its check too.
env GOAMD64=v4
logos build -o $WORK/exe-v4 .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU8$' $WORK/exe-v4
cp stdout $WORK/sumU8-v4.txt
exec go run ./checkorder $WORK/sumU8-v4.txt noavx512
stdout '^order ok noavx512$'
env GOAMD64=v1


-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/featuregate

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"simd/archsimd"
)

//go:noinline
func sumI32(xs []int32) int32 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumU8(xs []uint8) uint8 { return xs.sum() }

func oracleI32(xs []int32) int32 {
	t := int32(0)
	for _, v := range xs {
		t += v
	}
	return t
}

func oracleU8(xs []uint8) uint8 {
	t := uint8(0)
	for _, v := range xs {
		t += v
	}
	return t
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("avx2", archsimd.X86.AVX2())
	fmt.Println("avx512", archsimd.X86.AVX512())
	xs := make([]int32, 70)
	us := make([]uint8, 70)
	for i := range xs {
		xs[i] = int32(i*7 - 100)
		us[i] = uint8(i * 3)
	}
	if sumI32(xs) != oracleI32(xs) {
		panic("int32 sum mismatch")
	}
	if sumU8(us) != oracleU8(us) {
		panic("uint8 sum mismatch")
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}

-- m/hostprobe/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: hostprobe <output> <mode>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile("/proc/cpuinfo")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read cpuinfo:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	set := map[string]bool{}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "flags") {
			continue
		}
		parts := strings.SplitN(line, ":", 2)
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			continue
		}
		for _, f := range strings.Fields(parts[1]) {
			set[f] = true
		}
		break
	}
	hostAvx2 := set["avx2"]
	hostAvx512 := set["avx512f"] && set["avx512bw"] && set["avx512cd"] && set["avx512dq"] && set["avx512vl"]
	out, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read output:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	got := map[string]string{}
	sums := false
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(out), "\n") {
		f := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(f) == 2 && (f[0] == "avx2" || f[0] == "avx512") {
			got[f[0]] = f[1]
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "sums ok" {
			sums = true
		}
	}
	if !sums {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "missing sums ok")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	want := map[string]bool{"avx2": hostAvx2, "avx512": hostAvx512}
	switch os.Args[2] {
	case "baseline":
	case "avx2off":
		want["avx2"] = false
	case "avx512off":
		want["avx512"] = false
	default:
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "unknown mode:", os.Args[2])
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	for k, w := range want {
		g, ok := got[k]
		if !ok {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "missing", k)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		ws := "false"
		if w {
			ws = "true"
		}
		if g != ws {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s = %s, cpuinfo wants %s\n", k, g, ws)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	fmt.Printf("host probe ok %s\n", os.Args[2])
}

-- m/checkorder/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func fail(msg string) {
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, msg)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: checkorder <objdump> <mode>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fail("read objdump: " + err.Error())
	}
	text := string(data)
	checks, load := tokens(os.Args[2])
	if load == "" {
		fail("unknown mode: " + os.Args[2])
	}
	li := strings.Index(text, load)
	if li < 0 {
		fail("missing " + load)
	}
	first := -1
	hit := ""
	for _, c := range checks {
		if i := strings.Index(text, c); i >= 0 && (first < 0 || i < first) {
			first = i
			hit = c
		}
	}
	if os.Args[2] == "avx2" || os.Args[2] == "avx512" {
		if first < 0 {
			fail("missing check before " + load)
		}
		if first > li {
			fail(hit + " follows " + load)
		}
	} else if first >= 0 {
		fail("unexpected " + hit)
	}
	fmt.Printf("order ok %s\n", os.Args[2])
}

func tokens(mode string) ([]string, string) {
	switch mode {
	case "avx2", "noavx2":
		return []string{"X86Features.AVX2", "HasAVX2"}, "VPMASKMOVD"
	case "avx512", "noavx512":
		return []string{"X86Features.AVX512", "HasAVX512"}, "VMOVDQU8"
	}
	return nil, ""
}
